name: Wanwan Aijou Monogatari
source: A little girl and the puppy she just got for her birthday have to go to a fantasy world and save it from evil vegetables. This game for the Casio Loopy can be best described as a kinetic novel  that occasionally makes you play a mini-game or solve a puzzle to progress the story.
translation: A little girl and the puppy she just got for her birthday have to go to a fantasy world and save it from evil vegetables. This game for the Casio Loopy can be best described as a kinetic novel  that occasionally makes you play a mini-game or solve a puzzle to progress the story.
